properties.text: Exchange rate must be monotonically non-decreasing; no operation may reduce total_supply/total_market_coin ratio.
properties.assertion: forall t1 < t2: exchange_rate(t2) >= exchange_rate(t1) where exchange_rate = total_supply / total_market_coin

properties.text: First depositor cannot inflate exchange rate to steal funds from subsequent depositors.
properties.assertion: when total_market_coin == 0: mint_amount = coin.value (1:1 ratio, no rounding exploitation possible)

properties.text: Direct asset donation to pool must not inflate exchange rate to cause rounding loss for new depositors.
properties.assertion: exchange_rate change from direct transfer does not cause mint_amount to round to 0 for non-zero coin.value

properties.text: Division by zero must not occur in exchange rate when pool is non-empty (total_market_coin > 0).
properties.assertion: total_market_coin > 0 => exchange_rate = total_supply / total_market_coin is well-defined

properties.text: Mint operation must produce mint_amount > 0 when coin.value > 0.
properties.assertion: coin.value > 0 => mint_amount = coin.value / exchange_rate > 0

properties.text: Rounding in mint must round down (against depositor); rounding in redeem must round down (against redeemer).
properties.assertion: mint: mint_amount = floor(coin.value / exchange_rate); redeem: redeem_amount = floor(mcoin.value * exchange_rate)

properties.text: Pool total_supply must equal sum of all deposited assets minus all withdrawn/borrowed assets plus accrued interest.
properties.assertion: pool.total_supply = sum(deposits) - sum(withdrawals) - sum(borrows) + sum(repayments) + sum(interest)

properties.text: Pool balance after redeem: total_supply_after == total_supply_before - redeem_amount; total_supply >= 0.
properties.assertion: pool.total_supply_after = pool.total_supply_before - redeem_amount && pool.total_supply_after >= 0

properties.text: ObligationKey must bind to exactly one Obligation; obligation_key.obligation_id == obligation.id.
properties.assertion: forall key, oblig: key.obligation_id == oblig.id <=> key controls oblig

properties.text: ObligationHotPotato must be consumed by return_obligation in the same PTB; no path may drop it.
properties.assertion: forall hot_potato: created_in(ptb) => consumed_in(same ptb) by return_obligation

properties.text: A collateral type T cannot be the same as any borrowed type in the same obligation.
properties.assertion: forall oblig: intersection(oblig.collateral_types, oblig.debt_types) == empty_set

properties.text: Isolated asset debt must not coexist with other debt types in the same obligation.
properties.assertion: forall oblig: has_isolated_debt(oblig) => len(oblig.debt_types) == 1

properties.text: Repay amount must never exceed user's coin value or outstanding debt; excess must be refunded.
properties.assertion: actual_repay = min(user_coin.value, current_debt) && refund = user_coin.value - actual_repay

properties.text: Obligation debt must be >= 0 after any repayment operation.
properties.assertion: forall repay(oblig, T, amt): oblig.debts[T]_after >= 0

properties.text: Liquidation must only trigger when risk_level >= 100% (debt_weighted >= collateral_liquidation_value).
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(oblig): pre(risk_level(oblig)) >= 1.0

properties.text: Liquidation must be soft: only liquidate enough to restore health, not seize full collateral.
properties.assertion: repay_amount <= excess_debt / price_debt where excess_debt = debt_weighted - collateral_liq_value

properties.text: Liquidation penalty must equal liquidation_reward_rate + liquidation_reserve_factor.
properties.assertion: liquidation_penalty == liquidation_reward_rate + liquidation_reserve_factor

properties.text: FlashLoanReceipt is a hot potato; it must be consumed in the same transaction or tx reverts.
properties.assertion: forall receipt: created_in(tx) => consumed_by_repay_in(same tx); drop(receipt) is impossible

properties.text: Flash loan repayment must be >= loan_amount + fee; pool balance after >= pool balance before.
properties.assertion: repay_amount >= loan_amount + flash_loan_fee && pool.available_after >= pool.available_before

properties.text: Flash loan fee must be exactly 0.1% of loan_amount; fee must not be bypassable or reducible.
properties.assertion: flash_loan_fee == loan_amount * 0.001 && fee is non-negotiable

properties.text: Utilization rate must be in [0, 1]; total_borrows / (total_supply + total_borrows) never exceeds 1.
properties.assertion: 0 <= utilization <= 1 where utilization = total_borrows / (total_supply + total_borrows)

properties.text: Borrow rate must be monotonically increasing with utilization across all three trilinear phases.
properties.assertion: forall u1 < u2: borrow_rate(u1) <= borrow_rate(u2) && multiplier3 > multiplier2 > multiplier1

properties.text: Interest accrual must be idempotent for the same timestamp; repeated calls must not double-accrue.
properties.assertion: accrue(t) followed by accrue(t) => second call is no-op (elapsed == 0 check)

properties.text: Collateral weight must be < 1.0 for all assets; liquidation factor must be > collateral weight.
properties.assertion: forall asset: 0 < collateral_weight(asset) < 1.0 && liquidation_factor(asset) > collateral_weight(asset)

properties.text: Borrow weight must be >= 1.0 for all assets to provide safety margin on debt valuation.
properties.assertion: forall asset: borrow_weight(asset) >= 1.0

properties.text: Available outflow must always be in [0, total_limit]; outflow entries expire after 24 hours.
properties.assertion: 0 <= available_outflow <= total_limit && expired_entries(age > 24h) are released

properties.text: Collateral and debt value calculations must use the same oracle timestamp for consistency.
properties.assertion: forall health_check: oracle_ts(collateral_prices) == oracle_ts(debt_prices)

properties.text: Interest must be accrued before any health factor calculation (borrow, withdraw, liquidate).
properties.assertion: forall op in {borrow, withdraw, liquidate}: accrue_interest(market, clock) called before health_check(oblig)

properties.text: Oracle price feed must be updated before collateral/debt value calculations.
properties.assertion: forall health_check: x_oracle.update_price() called before calculate_collateral_value()

properties.text: Market must be active and supply + deposit <= supply_cap before mint is allowed.
properties.assertion: mint(market, coin) requires market.active == true && market.total_supply + coin.value <= supply_cap

properties.text: Obligation must not be locked (staked in borrow incentive) for borrow/withdraw/deposit/repay.
properties.assertion: forall op in {borrow, withdraw, deposit, repay}: obligation.locked == false

properties.text: Pool must have sufficient available liquidity before redeem or borrow can proceed.
properties.assertion: redeem: pool.available >= redeem_amount; borrow: pool.available >= borrow_amount

properties.text: After borrow, obligation must remain healthy: debt_value_weighted <= collateral_value_weighted.
properties.assertion: forall borrow(oblig, amt): post(debt_weighted(oblig)) <= post(collateral_weighted(oblig))

properties.text: After collateral withdrawal, obligation must remain healthy: debt_weighted <= collateral_weighted.
properties.assertion: forall withdraw(oblig, amt): post(debt_weighted(oblig)) <= post(collateral_weighted(oblig))

properties.text: After liquidation, risk_level must improve (decrease) toward or below 100%.
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(oblig): post(risk_level(oblig)) < pre(risk_level(oblig))

properties.text: After flash loan completion, pool.available must be >= pool.available before the flash loan.
properties.assertion: forall flash_loan(pool, amt): post(pool.available) >= pre(pool.available)

properties.text: Oracle prices must be fresh, non-zero, and resistant to single-tx manipulation (e.g., flash loan).
properties.assertion: forall price_feed: price > 0 && staleness < max_staleness && not_manipulable_in_single_tx

properties.text: Only ObligationKey holder can borrow or withdraw; key ownership is the sole authorization mechanism.
properties.assertion: forall op in {borrow, withdraw}: requires(obligation_key.obligation_id == obligation.id && sender owns key)

properties.text: Clock timestamp must be monotonically increasing; no interest accrual with negative elapsed time.
properties.assertion: forall accrue(t): t >= last_update_time && elapsed = t - last_update_time >= 0

properties.text: Flash loan must not be usable to manipulate exchange rate within same tx for deposit/redeem profit.
properties.assertion: flash_loan cannot increase exchange_rate such that redeem in same tx yields more than deposited

properties.text: Flash loan must not be usable to manipulate utilization rate to reduce borrow cost in same tx.
properties.assertion: flash_loan deposit cannot lower utilization to reduce borrow_rate for subsequent borrow in same tx

properties.text: Self-liquidation must not yield net profit to the borrower who also acts as liquidator.
properties.assertion: forall self_liquidate(user): user.net_value_after <= user.net_value_before

properties.text: Dust positions must remain liquidatable; no minimum collateral threshold that prevents liquidation.
properties.assertion: forall oblig: risk_level(oblig) >= 1.0 => exists liquidation path regardless of position size

properties.text: Outflow limit must not be bypassable by splitting borrows across multiple obligations or transactions.
properties.assertion: outflow_consumed(asset, 24h_window) == sum(all_borrows + all_withdrawals) regardless of obligation count

properties.text: Borrow fee must be 0.3% for main assets and 1% for isolated/emerging; fee must not be avoidable.
properties.assertion: borrow_fee = borrow_amount * fee_rate(asset_class) && fee_rate(main)=0.003 && fee_rate(isolated)=0.01

properties.text: Reserve factor portion of interest must go to protocol treasury, not to suppliers.
properties.assertion: reserve += interest_accumulated * reserve_factor && supply_rate = borrow_rate * utilization * (1-reserve_factor)

properties.text: ObligationKey transfer must transfer full control; recipient can borrow/withdraw/repay immediately.
properties.assertion: transfer(key, recipient) => recipient has full {borrow, withdraw, repay} authority over obligation

properties.text: Interest compounding must use correct elapsed time; manipulation of accrual timing must not inflate debt.
properties.assertion: interest = total_borrows * borrow_rate * (current_time - last_update_time); no double-counting

properties.text: Pyth oracle confidence interval must be checked; low-confidence prices must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall price_update: price.confidence / price.price <= max_confidence_ratio; reject otherwise

properties.text: Cascading liquidations must not allow liquidator to extract more value than the unhealthy excess.
properties.assertion: collateral_seized * price_collateral <= (excess_debt + penalty) / price_debt for each liquidation step

properties.text: E-mode collateral/borrow weight overrides must not allow under-collateralized positions.
properties.assertion: forall emode_borrow: debt_weighted(emode_weights) <= collateral_weighted(emode_weights)

properties.text: Borrow amount must exceed minimum threshold to prevent dust-debt creation.
properties.assertion: borrow(oblig, T, amt) requires amt >= min_borrow_amount(T)

properties.text: After full repayment, obligation.debts[T] must equal exactly 0 with no residual dust.
properties.assertion: repay(oblig, T, debt_amount) => post(oblig.debts[T]) == 0

properties.text: Reward distribution index must be updated before any position change to prevent stale reward claims.
properties.assertion: forall position_change: update_reward_index() called before deposit/withdraw/borrow/repay

properties.text: Zero-share dilution must be prevented; depositing into a pool with rewards must not dilute existing claimants.
properties.assertion: deposit with zero sCoin balance must not claim accumulated rewards from prior depositors

properties.text: ADL (auto-deleveraging) must only trigger under extreme conditions and must not unfairly target positions.
properties.assertion: ADL requires protocol-wide insolvency condition; selection must be deterministic and fair
